profile.headline: Sr software engineer at Phoenix Operations Group
profile.summary: Accomplished technology executive with 29 years of progressive leadership driving enterprise digital transformation, innovation, and operational excellence. Expertise in defining and executing IT strategy, architecting secure and scalable systems, and optimising cross-functional teams to deliver mission-critical solutions. Proven ability to align technology initiatives with organisational goals, foster high-performance cultures, and build strategic partnerships across business units and stakeholders.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Accomplished technology executive with 29 years of progressive leadership driving enterprise digital transformation, innovation, and operational excellence. Expertise in defining and executing IT strategy, architecting secure and scalable systems, and optimising cross-functional teams to deliver mission-critical solutions. Proven ability to align technology initiatives with organisational goals, foster high-performance cultures, and build strategic partnerships across business units and stakeholders.

positions.title: Lead Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
1. Full-Stack Development & System Design:
   - Led the design and development of simple and complex software applications, ensuring they are secure, scalable, and stable.
   - Collaborated with product managers, end users, and team leads to deliver solutions that meet user requirements.

2. Team Leadership & Agile Methodologies:
   - Successfully managed small to medium-sized development teams in an agile environment, fostering collaboration and communication.
   - Mentored team members on best practices in software development and project management.

3. DevSecOps Pipeline Implementation:
   - Spearheaded the transition of a critical software suite to a new DevSecOps pipeline, streamlining development processes and enhancing security measures.
   - Developed a converged system baseline, improving operational efficiency and collaboration among software teams.

4. Transformation of Software Applications:
   - Enhanced a specific intelligence support system by converting prototype software into a fully scalable application deployed in a containerized environment.
   - Established data-sharing interfaces with other platforms, facilitating seamless information exchange.

5. System Integration and Operation Optimization:
   - Managed the integration of various DevSecOps pipelines across multiple platforms, ensuring system performance can efficiently handle extensive daily operations.
   - Played a key role in preparing systems for future integration, significantly increasing their processing capabilities.

positions.title: Sr Software Architect
positions.description:
Designed and built a barcode based tracking system for prepackaged pharmaceuticals with plans for full e-Pedigree capabilities to meet pharmacy board regulations.

Actively performing programming, configuration and installation tasks for a prescription order fulfillment system as a team member using a newly adopted agile approach.

Working with team of developers to modify existing software to receive electronic prescriptions from Surescripts, and process pharmacy claims for customers through a clearinghouse.

Building a cloud-based system to simplify and standardize architecture which will enable licensee security, centralized inventory management, claims processing and cloud-based customer systems using IP-enabled devices such as page printers, label printers, barcode scanners, vending machines and touchscreen kiosks.

positions.title: Technology Consultant
positions.description:
Personally stabilized the production systems and formalized the documentation, installation and support processes of client site installations based on an undocumented prototype system.

Worked with 3rd party development firm to rewrite the system in Java to comply with HIPAA regulations and HL7 messaging specifications.

Personally modified the system to be compliant with DEA regulations for controlled substances

Designed and built a barcode based tracking system for prepackaged pharmaceuticals with plans for full e-Pedigree capabilities to meet pharmacy board regulations.

positions.title: Applications Developer
positions.description:
Key From Image (KFI) Data Entry Replacement Project
Workflow Framework Prototype for fulfillment, follow-up and batch transmissions

Forms Data Entry Prototype in ASP.NET

FDA Regulated Clinical Trial Publishing System & Patient Assistance Program

Platform Design and Development for Data Feed processing and monitoring

Design and develop new systems and support modifications and operations of existing systems

Provide estimate for planning, development, testing and support for own projects

Document and maintain system design and software life-cycle specifications from vision to cutover and version planning for future changes

Discuss program requirements, plan project timelines directly with client representatives and developers

Collaborate with other developers & LAN/WAN for Systems Implementation/Integration

positions.title: Applications Developer
positions.description:
Full Lifecycle Management for All Custom Software

Member of the Engineering Review Board and Emergency Response Team

Initiated use of coding standards and code reviews for the development team

Worked with several clients directly using verbal and written communication (Chase Manhattan, Fleet, First Data, Cybersource)

E-commerce shopping cart for a multiple store web site, with multi-store Product Search

Secure credit card transaction system front and back ends [CyberCash, CyberSource]

Generic Membership System with Individual and Mass Enrollment Capabilities 

Integration of Member E-mail and eCalendar services

Marketplace/Merchant Management System

Personalized Mass Email System with Campaign Management Tools for clients

2 Web Site Redesigns (1999, 2000) & System Architecture Redesign (2000)
